root_causes.description: A serving API pod has rendered configuration inconsistent with the desired release.
Payment retries use the wrong business idempotency identity.
A fulfillment consumer revision violates the current retry/event compatibility contract.
Mixed invalidator revisions leave stale cache entries.
Insufficient API processing capacity causes the incident.
Database connection starvation causes the incident.

actions.description: Replace only a proven drifted API pod.
Upgrade fulfillment consumers to the compatible contract.
Replace invalidators with the compatibility revision.
